name: path-pooja-website
description: Static public website for Path Pooja

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const required=['site/index.html','site/styles.css','site/payment-config.js']; const missing=required.filter((file)=>!fs.existsSync(file)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Missing static site files: '+missing.join(', ')); console.log('Static site is ready in ./site');"
